analyst_view.overall: Lyon are 13th with 7 points and need a win to push toward the top eight; Lillestrom are 34th with 1 point, have scored twice and conceded 10 in this phase and are close to elimination. New coach Carlos Vicens won 1-0 at Lille in his first game and now has his first home match, with Monaco next on Sunday. Pavel Sulc, Tyler Morton, Clinton Mata and Mohamed Ouedraogo are out and Lois Openda, back in training on Monday after a fibula injury, is uncertain; the numbers already take about 15% off Lyon for Sulc and Openda. Lillestrom are without Espen Garnas, with Lars Ranger and Daniel Bassi doubtful; an earlier report of a Gustav Nyheim ban is not backed up, as both previews have him in the expected XI. Austrian referee Sebastian Gishamer (about 4.2 cards a game) is in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals (Lyon 1.9) and already take about 15% off Lyon for Sulc and Openda. Openda may in fact make the squad, while Flashscore's expected XI has some changes (Duranville and Merah) before Monaco; the two pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 2.8, a change from my earlier small cut now that Nyheim looks available for Lillestrom.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.9 corners, 8.0 for Lyon, already up for their 38 corners in the last six. Vicens wants possession and pressing high up, which fits a game spent in Lillestrom's half, but some rotation pulls the other way, so I stay at 11.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards, with referee Sebastian Gishamer close to average (4.2 a game) and both sides' recent bookings already counted. A one-sided home game against a struggling side rarely gets heated, so I stay at 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.9 shots, 19.3 of them for Lyon. Lillestrom have not scored a first-half goal in this phase and Lyon should dominate, as the numbers already expect; rotation and a possible Openda return roughly cancel out, so I stay at 28.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.3 shots on target, already up for Lillestrom conceding 30 on target in six games. With nothing new beyond what they count, I stay at 11.3.
